payload.instruction: Change the background into a basketball court
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image show the background changed into a recognizable basketball court?
node.criteria: complete: the background reads as a basketball-court setting from visible court features, such as a court floor with recognizable markings and/or a hoop integrated into a court environment; basketball-themed objects alone against an otherwise generic or dark background are not sufficient. partial: the background has visibly progressed toward a basketball court (for example, a hoop or basketballs are present, or some court-like floor/markings appear), but the overall setting does not clearly read as a court. absent: no visible progress toward changing the background into a basketball court. unknown: evidence is insufficient to determine progress.
node.binding: Assess only the image background, distinguishing it from the preserved person. Judge whether the background itself visibly reads as a basketball court; do not treat basketball-themed props alone as sufficient or require unrequested details.

outcome.description: Change the image background into a basketball court.
